meta.title: Act 4 — The Seam
meta.note: The finale of Bonds of Red (game-story.md §4, issue #146). Only the ENTRY ships today — the receiving half of the Act 3 -> Act 4 seam (issue #162) — with its ordering final and its cast reassembly, its guardian quests and the `seam` zone left to their own issues.
meta.loading: On `act-3-complete`, through ACT_PACKAGES in main.ts (issue #209): NOT at boot, because unlike the sea and the sky nothing of this act is part of the open world's geography — the act stages out of the Encampment, and its one new place is a zone entered in quest 5. Once loaded it stays for the session.
meta.the-seam: Given AND closed by npc:gain at the Encampment (core.json — an id is global and core may not depend on a package that arrives later, so his rows sit beside him). The prerequisite is the door for THIS quest; everything else in the act tests seam-known.

data._seam: THE ACT 3 -> ACT 4 SEAM, receiving half — the campaign's only homecoming: the balloon comes back down and the whole cast is at the Encampment fire.

objectives._hear: Gain's offer row marks it, as first-light's talk-to-gain: the fire is his.

objectives._stub: Meant to be satisfied by STARTING any of the three guardian quests (issue #162), which do not exist yet and want a quest-start trigger kind. Until then Gain's turn-in row marks it in the same breath it closes — the way Vane's offer marked the boarding before the balloon flew (issue #261).
